Authors: Chuhan Meng, Haiyan Yin

Topological Necessities: Mechanism-Invariant Strategic Subgoals for Cross-Embodiment Goal-Conditioned Control RLRobot

topological subgoals homology goal-conditioned RL cross-embodiment transfer offline trajectories

简要说明：本文提出拓扑必要性——通过同调从离线轨迹中恢复的、跨具身不变的策略性子目标——用于目标条件控制，提升了AntMaze、Humanoid和Kitchen等长时程任务的表现。

TLDR: This paper introduces topological necessities—mechanism-invariant strategic subgoals recovered from offline trajectories via homology—that transfer across embodiments for goal-conditioned control, improving long-horizon tasks like AntMaze, Humanoid, and Kitchen.

Abstract: Long-horizon goal-conditioned reinforcement learning delegates control to a high-level module that proposes subgoals, but existing subgoals are implicit byproducts of value functions or latent actions, tied to the executor that produced them. We study a different object: a route-conditioned order of unavoidable stages that every successful executor must traverse, recoverable from offline trajectories and belonging to none of them. Its defining properties are topological: an unskippable stage is a separating set that every admissible path must cross, and a loop in free space forces a route choice. We read the two by homology in dimensions 0 and 1 over a transport-weighted carrier built from successful trajectories, yielding an enumerable gate set with shell-level certificates; the certified gates are what we call topological necessities. Certified gates enter the decision loop as a recursive topological gate hierarchy. Under a fixed, isomorphic free space, the object survives executor replacement: gates frozen on PointMaze data transfer without retraining to Ant and Humanoid, attaining the highest Humanoid aggregate under a unified interface (96.1), with +36.0 over a map-privileged reference on the multi-route task (p=1.4e-5); the planner saturates PointMaze (100+/-0) and matches or exceeds the strongest baselines on AntMaze (giant +22.9) and Kitchen (+15.8/+12.6).

摘要（中文）：长视野目标条件强化学习将控制权委托给一个高层模块，由其提出子目标，但现有的子目标本质上是价值函数或潜在动作的隐式副产品，与产生它们的执行器绑定。我们研究了一种不同的对象：一种以路径为条件的、所有成功执行器都必须穿越的不可跳过阶段的有序序列，它可以从离线轨迹中恢复，且不属于任何单一执行器。其定义性属性是拓扑性质的：不可跳过的阶段是一个分离集，所有可行路径都必须穿过它；而自由空间中的回路则强制产生路径选择。我们通过同调在维度0和1上，基于由成功轨迹构建的传输加权载体来解读这两类属性，从而得到一个可枚举的门集合及其壳层级证书；这些经过认证的门被称为拓扑必然项。经过认证的门以递归拓扑门层级的形式进入决策循环。在固定且同构的自由空间下，该对象在执行器替换后依然保持有效：在PointMaze数据上冻结的门无需重新训练即可迁移至Ant和Humanoid，在统一接口下达到最高的Humanoid综合得分（96.1），并在多路径任务上比具有地图特权信息的参考方法高出+36.0（p=1.4e-5）；该规划器在PointMaze上达到饱和（100±0），在AntMaze（giant +22.9）和Kitchen（+15.8/+12.6）上匹配或超越最强基线。

Authors: Hao Shi, Xi Li

Testing Between the Test Cases: Proving End-to-End Steering in Conditions You Never Drove AutonomousDriving

formal verification end-to-end steering bound propagation CARLA lane departure

简要说明：本文提出使用边界传播对训练好的端到端转向网络进行形式化验证，以证明在未测试的干扰强度下的车道保持性能，作为自动驾驶仿真测试的补充。

TLDR: This paper proposes using formal verification via bound propagation on trained end-to-end steering networks to prove lane-keeping performance under untested disturbance intensities, complementing simulation-based testing for automated driving.

Abstract: AI-based automated vehicle testing is challenging because a model that passes every test condition can still fail in the real world. Formal verification offers a way to directly address this gap. On a simulated highway and an arterial road we trained two small end-to-end steering networks each in CARLA, one on clear conditions alone and one on clear, fog, night and low sun. All four models were driven against a 2.19 ft lane-departure budget. Without driving again, we used bound propagation, a formal method that reads the trained weights, to compute how far steering can drift at every disturbance strength between two captured images. One calculation covers more than a campaign could drive: on the arterial it spans 133 poses, where ten intensities each would be 10^133 combinations, in minutes on one GPU. Not only did formal verification find conditions that broke the clear-trained policy without simulation testing, it provided some preliminary evidence for potential failures between the test cases. Our overall conclusion is that formal verification is a viable complement to simulation, and could be adopted as a part of verification and validation for automated driving.

摘要（中文）：基于人工智能的自动驾驶车辆测试面临挑战，因为即便一个模型能通过所有测试工况，在现实世界中仍可能失效。形式化验证为直接弥合这一差距提供了途径。我们在CARLA模拟环境中，分别针对高速公路和主干道训练了两个小型端到端转向控制网络，其中一个仅在晴朗条件下训练，另一个则在晴朗、雾天、夜间和低角度阳光条件下训练。所有四个模型均以2.19英尺的车道偏离预算进行测试。在不进行额外驾驶的情况下，我们利用边界传播这一读取训练权重的形式化方法，计算了在两帧捕获图像之间，每个扰动强度下转向偏移的最大可能范围。一次计算所覆盖的范围远超大规模测试驾驶：在主干道上，该计算涵盖133个位姿，若每个位姿取10种强度，则相当于10^133种组合，而整个过程仅需在一张GPU上运行几分钟。形式化验证不仅发现了晴朗条件下训练的策略在无仿真测试情况下会失效的工况，还为测试用例之间可能存在的潜在失效提供了初步证据。我们的总体结论是，形式化验证可作为仿真测试的有效补充，并有望纳入自动驾驶验证与确认流程的一部分。

Authors: Menuka Ghalan, Charles Rodgers, Zachary D. Asher

Planning along Differentiable Charts of Constraint Manifolds with General-Purpose IK Solvers Manipulation

inverse kinematics constraint manifolds gradient-based optimization inverse function theorem trajectory optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种利用逆函数定理计算解析IK参数化梯度的方法，使得在运动学约束下的机械臂轨迹优化成为可能，并进行了硬件演示。

TLDR: This paper presents a method to compute gradients for analytic IK parameterizations of constraint manifolds using the inverse function theorem, enabling gradient-based trajectory optimization for robot manipulators under kinematic constraints, with a hardware demonstration.

Abstract: Planning trajectories for robot manipulators under kinematic equality constraints restricts feasible motions to a measure-zero submanifold of the configuration space, requiring special algorithmic treatment. A promising strategy is parametrizing the set of feasible configurations using analytic inverse kinematics (IK). Bespoke analytic IK functions can be written to be differentiable, a necessary property for gradient-based trajectory optimization. But the vast majority of IK functions are computed by automated meta-solvers like IKFast, and are difficult to modify for differentiability. We present a new approach for computing gradients of analytic IK parameterizations: we leverage the inverse function theorem to recover the desired gradients from the ordinary forward kinematic Jacobian. Furthermore, we present a least-squares domain extension and an optimization-amenable description of the reachability constraint, which preserves gradient signal outside the reachable workspace. We demonstrate the efficacy of our approach through numerical experiments and downstream tasks, including a hardware demonstration of an RB-Y1 picking up a box and placing it on a table. Project website: https://cohnt.github.io/inverse-function-theorem-parameterization/

摘要（中文）：规划机器人在运动学等式约束下的轨迹，会将可行运动限制在构型空间中的一个测度零子流形上，因此需要特殊的算法处理。一种有前景的策略是利用解析逆运动学（IK）对可行构型集进行参数化。定制解析IK函数可以设计为可微的，这是基于梯度的轨迹优化所必需的属性。然而，绝大多数IK函数是由IKFast等自动化元求解器计算得到的，难以修改以实现可微性。我们提出了一种计算解析IK参数化梯度的新方法：利用反函数定理，从普通正运动学雅可比矩阵中恢复所需的梯度。此外，我们提出了一种最小二乘域扩展以及可优化描述的可达性约束，从而在可达工作空间之外保留梯度信号。我们通过数值实验和下游任务验证了该方法的有效性，包括RB-Y1机器人拾取盒子并放置到桌子上的硬件演示。项目网站：https://cohnt.github.io/inverse-function-theorem-parameterization/

Authors: Thomas Cohn, Seiji Shaw, Harel Biggie, Travis Manderson, Nicholas Roy, Russ Tedrake

Expressive Robotic Pianist: Mastering Complex Piano Repertoire with Graph-Mimic and Musical Dynamics Manipulation

reinforcement learning dexterous manipulation graph-based optimization acoustic model expressive control

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于强化学习的控制框架，使灵巧机器人手能以类人的表现力弹奏钢琴，通过基于图的优化生成指法和物理启发的声学模型控制力度。评估显示在指法相似性、速度准确性和感知偏好上优于基线方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning-based control framework for a dexterous robotic hand to play piano with human-like expressiveness, using graph-based optimization for fingering and a physics-inspired acoustic model for dynamic control. Evaluations show superior performance over baselines in fingering similarity, velocity accuracy, and perceptual preference.

Abstract: Enabling robots to perform musical instruments with human-level expressivity represents a frontier in bridging the gap between mechanical precision and artistic interpretation. Despite advances in robotic dexterity, replicating the fluid finger transitions and nuanced dynamic control characteristic of human pianists remains a significant challenge. Through a reinforcement learning-based control framework, we demonstrate that a dexterous robotic hand can achieve high-fidelity performance across a diverse piano repertoire. Central to our approach is a graph-based optimization strategy that guides the robot to generate natural pre-press and key-press fingering strategies that closely resemble human movement patterns. To achieve expressive sound production, the control system is coupled with a physics-inspired acoustic model that modulates keypress velocity to accurately reproduce the dynamic variations specified in musical scores. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that our expressive control model significantly outperforms baseline methods in both finger morphology similarity and dynamic velocity accuracy. In a perceptual test involving participants from diverse listener groups, performances generated by our system are significantly preferred over baseline robotic performances and are indistinguishable from human performances for non-professional audiences. Furthermore, extensive experiments across multiple musical styles confirm that our method maintains high note-level accuracy while achieving expressive performance. Our approach provides a robust pathway for robotic systems to move beyond mere mechanical accuracy, elevating robotic musicianship to a level of expressive performance comparable to human pianists.

摘要（中文）：使机器人以人类水平的表現力演奏乐器，代表着弥合机械精确性与艺术诠释之间鸿沟的前沿课题。尽管机器人灵巧操作能力已取得进展，但复现人类钢琴家特有的流畅手指转换和细腻力度控制仍然是一项重大挑战。通过基于强化学习的控制框架，我们证明灵巧机器人手能够在多种钢琴曲目中实现高保真演奏。我们方法的核心是一种基于图的优化策略，引导机器人生成与人类运动模式高度接近的自然预压和按键指法策略。为实现富有表现力的声音生成，控制系统与受物理学启发的声学模型耦合，该模型调节按键速度以精确再现乐谱中规定的力度变化。定量评估表明，我们的表现力控制模型在手指形态相似性和力度速度准确性方面均显著优于基线方法。在一项涉及不同听众群体的感知测试中，我们系统生成的演奏显著优于基线机器人演奏，且对于非专业听众而言与人类演奏难以区分。此外，跨多种音乐风格的广泛实验证实，我们的方法在保持高音符级准确性的同时实现了富有表现力的演奏。我们的方法为机器人系统超越单纯的机械准确性提供了一条稳健路径，将机器人音乐表现力提升至与人类钢琴家相当的水平。

Authors: Yanhong Liang, Xianwei Liu, Chaojie Fu, Shaowen Cheng, Yanyan Yuan, Chengwei Zhuo, Xi Chen, Yongbin Jin, Wei Yang, Hongtao Wang

When Information is Worth the Risk: Behavioral Valuation for Hazardous Robotic Exploration RLRobot

hazardous exploration behavioral valuation Prelec probability weighting information-risk frontier failure-truncated planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于危险机器人探索的估值层框架，利用Prelec概率加权构建风险增强的行为信息目标，以在信息获取与机器人失效风险之间取得平衡，并在网格世界实验中证明该方法能在保持与标准风险感知基线帕累托竞争力的同时减少危险暴露。

TLDR: This paper introduces a valuation-layer framework for hazardous robotic exploration, using Prelec probability weighting to create a risk-augmented Behavioral Information objective that balances information gain against the risk of robot failure, and demonstrates in grid-world experiments that this approach can reduce hazard exposure while remaining Pareto-competitive with standard risk-aware baselines.

Abstract: Hazardous robotic exploration requires robots to map spatial risks, such as unsafe terrain, radiation, fire, mines, or structural damage, while operating where collecting information can itself cause failure. A highly informative path may expose the robot to hazards, terminate execution, and prevent future observations. Hazardous exploration therefore requires deciding not only where uncertainty is largest, but when reducing it is worth the risk. This paper introduces a valuation-layer view of this problem. We keep the belief update, sensor model, physical risk model, and finite-horizon informative planner fixed, and change only the scalar objective used to rank feasible paths. Within this framework, we introduce a risk-augmented Behavioral Information objective based on Prelec probability weighting, yielding an interpretable family of conservative-to-aggressive information-risk valuations. Theoretically, we show that valuation parameters create switching boundaries between high-information/high-risk and lower-information/lower-risk paths, and induce a transformed Pareto-frontier structure over feasible exploration policies. Large-scale failure-truncated grid-world experiments show that valuation alone reshapes the information-risk frontier. Shannon information planning remains a strong raw-information baseline, while risk-aware objectives can reduce hazard exposure and robot losses by avoiding failures that truncate future sensing. Risk-augmented Behavioral valuation is Pareto-competitive with standard risk-aware baselines and provides interpretable conservative and intermediate regimes. These results support a framework in which robots reason not only about how much uncertainty an action reduces, but whether that reduction is worth the risk required to obtain it.

摘要（中文）：危险环境下的机器人探索要求机器人在执行任务时绘制空间风险图，例如不安全地形、辐射、火灾、地雷或结构损坏，而在这些环境中收集信息本身就可能导致任务失败。一条信息量丰富的路径可能使机器人暴露于危险之中，导致执行中断，并阻碍后续观测。因此，危险环境下的探索不仅需要决定不确定性最大的位置，还需要判断降低不确定性是否值得承担相应的风险。本文针对该问题提出了一种估值层视角。我们保持信念更新、传感器模型、物理风险模型和有限时域信息规划器不变，仅改变用于对可行路径进行排序的标量目标函数。在该框架下，我们引入了一种基于Prelec概率加权的风险增强行为信息目标函数，从而生成一个可解释的、从保守到激进的系列信息-风险评估策略。理论上，我们证明了估值参数会在高信息/高风险路径与低信息/低风险路径之间产生切换边界，并在可行探索策略集合上诱导出变换后的帕累托前沿结构。大规模截断失败网格世界实验表明，仅估值本身即可重塑信息-风险前沿。香农信息规划仍然是一个强力的原始信息基线，而风险感知目标函数通过避免截断后续感知的失败，可减少危险暴露和机器人损失。风险增强行为估值与标准风险感知基线在帕累托意义上具有竞争力，并提供可解释的保守和中间模式。这些结果支持一个框架，在该框架中，机器人不仅推理某个动作能减少多少不确定性，还判断这种减少是否值得为获取它而承担相应风险。

Authors: Alkesh K. Srivastava, Aamodh Suresh, Carlos Nieto-Granda, Philip Dames

When Validation Stops Learning: Auditing Update Admission for Continual Embodied Agents RLRobot

continual learning update admission embodied agents error control auditing protocol

简要说明：本文为持续具身智能体提出了一种准入审计协议，在错误控制与保留学习机会之间取得平衡。它在推挤诊断中识别了基于范围的门的局限性，并提供了分析和合成证据，但物理机器人和VLA验证仍然开放。

TLDR: This paper proposes an admission-audit protocol for continual embodied agents, balancing error control against retained learning opportunities. It identifies limitations of range-based gates and provides analytical and synthetic evidence in a pushing diagnostic, though physical-robot and VLA validation remain open.

Abstract: Independent evaluation can reject harmful policy updates yet also prevent useful continual learning. We argue that update admission must be assessed through both error control and retained learning opportunities at a stated interaction budget. We identify a concrete failure: a range-based confidence gate cannot certify unchanged old-task behavior within otherwise substantial budgets. A standard paired-binomial construction reduces this burden when outcome disagreements are rare. We also specify certified historical-reference promotion and a round-level missed-opportunity metric. In a constructed one-step pushing diagnostic with 32 seeds, fresh paired checks admit 31.6% of a common update stream at 2,000 episodes per stage, versus zero for the range-based gate; unconditional replay nevertheless learns better in closed-loop runs. A separate learned-dynamics stress test distinguishes model bias from feedback-selection error. The contribution is an admission-audit protocol with analytical and synthetic evidence; physical-robot and VLA validation remain open.

摘要（中文）：独立评估能够拒绝有害的策略更新，但也可能阻碍有价值的持续学习。我们认为，更新准入必须在既定的交互预算下，同时通过错误控制与保留学习机会两方面进行审查。我们识别出一个具体缺陷：基于区间的置信门控在相当大的预算范围内无法证明旧任务行为保持不变。当结果分歧较为罕见时，标准的配对二项构造可减轻这一负担。我们还明确了经认证的历史参考提升机制，以及轮次级别的机会错失度量指标。在一个人为构造的单步推挤诊断实验中，基于32个随机种子的结果表明，新鲜配对检查在每个阶段2000个回合下可接受31.6%的常见更新流，而基于区间的门控则为0%；尽管如此，在闭环运行中，无条件回放仍能实现更好的学习效果。另一项独立的动力学压力测试区分了模型偏差与反馈选择误差。本研究的贡献在于提出了一套带有分析与合成证据的准入审计协议；物理机器人与VLA验证仍待开展。

Authors: Qinzhen Ma, Ruihai Wu

Visual-SLAM for the detection of hidden tomatoes in greenhouses by Hierarchical Localization and GLOMAP for robotized harvesting Perception3D

Visual-SLAM GLOMAP Hierarchical Localization Agricultural Robotics 3D Mapping

简要说明：本文提出了一种低成本的单目视觉SLAM系统，结合GLOMAP与层次化定位实现对温室番茄作物的建图，成功识别被遮挡的番茄，并通过地面真值验证了几何精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-cost monocular Visual-SLAM system integrating GLOMAP and Hierarchical Localization to map tomato crops in greenhouses, successfully identifying occluded tomatoes and validating geometric accuracy against ground truth.

Abstract: Advanced crop monitoring inside greenhouses is becoming one of the primary objectives of research centers. High-performance sensors, such as LiDAR or stereo cameras, have traditionally been employed for this purpose, though these often have a high cost. This work proposes a Visual-SLAM system using a monocular camera, which is significantly more cost-effective and specifically tailored for agricultural applications, such as mapping tomato crops in a greenhouse. Tests were carried out on a real tomato bunch, located in the Agroconnect experimental greenhouse. A ROS 2 Humble node was developed to run on the robot in order to capture images of these crops, which were then stored for offline processing. To generate a 3D mapped model for the crop in the greenhouse, the GLOMAP mapper, based on Structure-From-Motion, was integrated with the Hierarchical Localization toolbox. This initial mapping is a foundation for future, more advanced algorithms to analyze growth patterns, and optimize agricultural management. The system leverages a hierarchical localization paradigm based on a coarse-to-fine strategy: it first performs global retrieval to generate location hypotheses, then combines local features within the identified candidate regions. The results show a correct identification of the tomato cluster, correctly characterising the tomato that is occluded and inaccessible by classical vision technologies. The reconstructed 3D model was further validated against manual ground-truth measurements of fruit size, centroid position, and orientation, confirming the geometric accuracy of the proposed low-cost monocular pipeline.

摘要（中文）：温室内的先进作物监测正日益成为研究中心的主要目标之一。高性能传感器，如激光雷达或立体相机，传统上被用于此目的，但这些传感器通常成本较高。本研究提出了一种使用单目相机的视觉SLAM系统，该系统在成本效益上显著更优，且专门针对农业应用进行了定制，例如温室中番茄作物的地图构建。实验在Agroconnect实验温室内对真实的番茄果串进行了测试。开发了一个运行于机器人上的ROS 2 Humble节点，用于采集这些作物的图像，并将图像存储以供离线处理。为了生成温室内作物的三维地图模型，将基于运动恢复结构的GLOMAP映射器与分层定位工具箱进行了集成。这一初步地图构建为未来更高级的算法分析生长模式、优化农业管理奠定了基础。该系统采用基于由粗到精策略的分层定位范式：首先执行全局检索以生成位置假设，然后在识别出的候选区域内结合局部特征。结果表明，系统能够正确识别番茄果簇，并准确刻画了被遮挡且传统视觉技术无法触及的番茄。重建的三维模型进一步与果实大小、质心位置和朝向的人工实测数据进行了验证，证实了所提出的低成本单目管道的几何准确性。

Authors: Fernando Cañadas-Aránega, José C. Moreno, José L. Blanco-Claraco, Francisco Rodríguez

GeoTrussRover: Morphological Computation with Contact-Semantic Control Primitives Locomotion

reconfigurable robots variable-geometry truss contact-semantic control primitives morphological computation physics-constrained projection

简要说明：GeoTrussRover结合可变几何桁架与轮式基座，利用接触语义控制原语适应障碍物高度，相比完整重计算减少了63.7%的计算量。

TLDR: GeoTrussRover uses a variable-geometry truss and wheeled base with contact-semantic control primitives to adapt to obstacle heights, reducing computation by 63.7% versus full recomputation.

Abstract: Reconfigurable robots can change their contact geometry when a fixed body cannot negotiate an obstacle. A variable-geometry truss (VGT) distributes this shape change through a load-bearing structure, but coupling it to a mobile base creates a high-dimensional coordination problem. GeoTrussRover combines an electrically actuated VGT, a wheeled base, and contact-semantic morphology planning and control. We solve one source traversal and extract four contact-semantic primitives that describe coordination among 21 members. Physics-constrained projection adapts them to unseen step heights with the same contact topology. When every phase remains feasible, adaptation does not recompute the complete motion. If one phase violates the new physical constraints, only that phase is recomputed. A full-space QP then tracks the adapted motion and corrects member and wheel errors. For transfer from 0.10m to 0.075m, the method reduces objective-function evaluations by 63.7% relative to full recomputation. Contact-phase feasibility analysis covers step heights from 0.10 to 0.46m, or 1.08 to 4.97 wheel radii, with the upper value near the theoretical feasible boundary. The electric prototype traverses 2.11 wheel radii. The resulting low-dimensional representation stores task coordination in a hyper-redundant, load-bearing morphology and reuses it during locomotion.

摘要（中文）：可重构机器人在固定机体无法越障时，能够改变其接触几何构型。变几何桁架通过承载结构分布这种形状变化，但将其与移动底盘耦合会产生高维协调问题。GeoTrussRover将电驱动变几何桁架、轮式底盘以及接触语义形态规划与控制相结合。我们求解了一次信源穿越，并提取了四种描述21个构件间协调关系的接触语义原语。物理约束投影使这些原语能够适应具有相同接触拓扑的未知台阶高度。当每个阶段均保持可行时，适应过程无需重新计算完整运动；若某一阶段违反新的物理约束，则仅重新计算该阶段。随后，全空间二次规划跟踪适应后的运动，并修正构件与车轮误差。在从0.10米到0.075米的转移场景中，该方法相较完全重新计算减少了63.7%的目标函数评估次数。接触阶段可行性分析覆盖了0.10至0.46米（即1.08至4.97个车轮半径）的台阶高度，其上限接近理论可行边界。电动样机成功穿越了2.11个车轮半径的障碍。所得到的低维表示将任务协调存储在超冗余承载形态中，并在运动过程中加以复用。

Authors: Muyuan Ma, Yi Zhang, Yang Yang, Xuanyan Zheng, Ruiqi Hu, Boxuan Ke, Zhenyu Chen, Yicong Lin, Xin Hao Yang, Daliang Xiao, Zhinan Hou, Wanhao Niu, Yuan Sun, Yan Yang, Yue Xie

GRADE: Single-Frame Generative Radar Depth Estimation Under Visual Degradation Perception3D

radar depth estimation latent diffusion metric depth smoke/fog degradation single-frame radar

简要说明：GRADE利用基于单帧雷达几何的潜在扩散模型，在视觉退化条件下估计稠密度量深度，在清晰和烟雾条件下均取得高精度。

TLDR: GRADE uses a latent diffusion backbone grounded in single-frame radar geometry to estimate dense metric depth under visual degradation, achieving high accuracy in clear and smoky conditions.

Abstract: Dense 3D depth perception fails under smoke, fog, and darkness because optical sensors cannot penetrate airborne particulates. mmWave radar remains usable and measures range accurately under these conditions, but its small aperture limits angular resolution. We present GRADE, which grounds a pretrained generative prior in single-frame radar geometry to estimate high-fidelity metric depth. GRADE first maps raw 4D radar spectra to coarse metric depth. A latent diffusion backbone then recovers structural detail while conditioning every denoising step on this estimate. A pixel-space adapter uses residual camera cues when available and is trained across clear, smoke-degraded, and occluded inputs so the full output approaches the radar-conditioned path as visibility degrades. Trained and evaluated on ~95K frames across 12 buildings with real smoke, GRADE achieves an MAE of 0.303 m in clear scenes and 0.313 m under smoke, outperforming existing baselines. Code and datasets are available at https://phi-lab-rice.github.io/GRADE.

摘要（中文）：密集三维深度感知在烟雾、雾霾和黑暗环境中会失效，因为光学传感器无法穿透空气中的颗粒物。毫米波雷达在这些条件下依然可用，并能准确测量距离，但其较小的孔径限制了角度分辨率。我们提出了GRADE方法，将预训练的生成先验嵌入单帧雷达几何中，以估计高保真度量深度。GRADE首先将原始4D雷达频谱映射为粗略的度量深度，随后由潜在扩散主干网络恢复结构细节，并在每一步去噪过程中以该估计为条件。像素空间适配器在可用时利用残余相机线索，并在清晰、烟尘退化和遮挡输入上进行训练，使得随着可见度下降，整体输出逐渐趋向于以雷达为条件的路径。我们在12栋建筑的真实烟雾环境中，使用约9.5万帧数据进行了训练和评估，GRADE在清晰场景中达到0.303米的平均绝对误差(MAE)，在烟雾条件下为0.313米，优于现有基线方法。代码和数据集可在 https://phi-lab-rice.github.io/GRADE 获取。

Authors: Bin Zhao, Patrick Chiou, Nakul Garg

World in World: Explore the World with World Models WorldModel

video world model camera control inference-time interface self-attention correspondence routing

简要说明：World in World 提出了一种免训练的推理时接口，通过将异构控制证据转换为基于注意力的令牌级对应关系，使冻结的自回归视频世界模型支持相机控制的重新渲染、长期重访以及人体动作迁移。

TLDR: World in World presents a training-free inference-time interface that enables camera-controlled rerendering, long-horizon revisiting, and human-motion transfer in frozen autoregressive video world models by converting heterogeneous control evidence into token-level correspondences via a shared attention-based mechanism.

Abstract: Autoregressive video world models enable interactive, long-horizon exploration, but flexible control remains challenging. Exploring a source video from new viewpoints requires the generated rollout to remain synchronised with the recorded event, place observed content in the requested view, plausibly complete newly exposed regions, and recover previously generated appearance on revisits. Existing methods typically address these requirements through task-specific modules or additional training. We present World in World, a training-free inference-time interface that converts heterogeneous control evidence into camera- and time-labelled clean visual states, which are read through the native self attention of a frozen causal video model. The evidence comprises source-video observations, target-view scene projections, geometry renderings that guide completion of newly exposed subject regions, and retrieved generated states beyond the rolling cache. Each evidence source carries token-level support and its own availability schedule. A correspondence router combines persistent point identities with geometry to establish token correspondences, guiding supported queries towards matching source-video tokens. Evidence-wise attention CFG (EWA) then independently regulates each auxiliary channel's additional contribution using attention responses from the same denoising forward pass. The shared interface supports camera-controlled rerendering, long-horizon revisiting, and human-motion transfer with the same frozen backbone. We evaluate World in World on camera-controlled video rerendering under diverse viewpoint changes, assessing perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and camera-following accuracy.

摘要（中文）：自回归视频世界模型能够实现交互式、长时程的探索，但灵活控制仍具有挑战性。从新视角探索源视频，要求生成的展开序列与记录事件保持同步，将已观测内容置于请求的视图中，合理补全新暴露的区域，并在回访时恢复先前生成的外观。现有方法通常通过任务专用模块或额外训练来解决这些需求。我们提出了“世界中世界”（World in World），一种无需训练的推理时接口，将异构控制证据转换为带相机和时间标签的干净视觉状态，并通过冻结的因果视频模型的原生自注意力机制进行读取。证据包括源视频观测、目标视角场景投影、引导新暴露主体区域补全的几何渲染，以及超出滚动缓存范围的检索生成状态。每个证据源都携带令牌级支持及其自身的可用性调度。对应关系路由器将持久点身份与几何信息相结合以建立令牌对应关系，引导受支持的查询匹配到对应的源视频令牌。随后，证据级注意力CFG（EWA）利用同一去噪前向传播中的注意力响应，独立调节每个辅助通道的额外贡献。该共享接口支持相机控制的重渲染、长时程回访以及人体运动迁移，且均使用相同的冻结主干网络。我们在多种视角变化下对World in World的相机控制视频重渲染进行了评估，考察了感知质量、时间一致性和相机跟随精度。

Authors: Chenxi Song, Yanming Yang, Chi Zhang

Certified Safety Curation: Distribution-Free Guarantees for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

safe offline RL filter-then-clone Learn-then-Test calibration distribution-free guarantees behavior cloning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于安全离线强化学习的先过滤后克隆流程，通过从片段比较中训练的状态值选择安全轨迹，并使用无分布认证保证，随后进行行为克隆。

TLDR: This paper proposes a filter-then-clone pipeline for safe offline reinforcement learning, where a state-only value trained from segment comparisons selects safe trajectories with distribution-free certified guarantees, followed by behavior cloning.

Abstract: Safe offline reinforcement learning assumes a cost function on every transition. We ask what remains possible when safety can be judged only by comparing short clips and occasionally asking whether an episode exceeded its budget. Certified safety curation answers with a filter-then-clone pipeline: a state-only value trained from segment comparisons scores whole trajectories, Learn-then-Test calibration certifies a selection threshold under a distribution-free $(α, δ)$ bound on the unsafe fraction of the selection, and behavior cloning follows. We are not aware of prior work certifying the composition of a training set for offline RL or imitation. Oracle controls justify the design: reweighting individual transitions fails even with an exact value, so the value selects whole trajectories. The policies satisfy the cost budget on eleven of fifteen DSRL tasks, one short of cloning the ground-truth safe subset, which needs a label on every trajectory; the uncertified variant reaches twelve. Retrained on the certified selection, the strongest full-label method becomes safe where no setting of its own cost target rescues it. Refusal is predictable: the certificate's probability has a closed form in the purity the pool attains, which the calibration sample estimates and the scorer enters only through.

摘要（中文）：安全离线强化学习假设在每次状态转移时都有一个代价函数。我们探讨的问题是：当安全性只能通过比较短视频片段，并偶尔询问某一回合是否超出预算来判断时，仍然能够实现哪些目标。经过认证的安全性策展通过“先过滤、后克隆”的流程给出答案：一个仅基于状态的值函数，通过片段比较训练得到，用于为完整轨迹评分；随后采用学习-再测试校准方法，在无分布假设的$(α, δ)$界限下，对所选集合中不安全比例进行认证，从而确定一个选择阈值；最后进行行为克隆。据我们所知，此前没有工作对离线强化学习或模仿学习中训练集的组合进行过认证。对照组实验验证了该设计的合理性：即使使用精确的值函数，对单次状态转移进行重新加权也无法成功，因此该值函数选择的是完整轨迹。该策略在十五个DSRL任务中的十一个上满足了代价预算，仅比使用真实安全子集进行克隆的方法少一个任务——后者需要对每条轨迹进行标注；未经过认证的变体则在十二个任务上达标。在经认证的选择集上重新训练后，最强的全标签方法变得安全，而在其自身代价目标的各种设置下都无法实现安全性。拒绝行为是可预测的：认证概率在池所达到的纯度上具有闭式表达，该纯度由校准样本估计，且评分器仅在这一点上与其相关。
